title: injected.json
description: Each attack, its log, and the rows it reaches.

start.description: When the replay starts, in epoch seconds.

stop.description: When the replay stops, in epoch seconds.

source.description: The time in the donor log the replay copies from.

log.description: The attacked log's path under the data directory.

first.description: The first row the attack reaches, counted over every row of the test set.

last.description: The last row the attack reaches, counted the same way.
